comment: API error codes (exact or a family ending in .*) that deliberately have no entry in @nodestro/ui-help, each with its reason. Checked by test/components/help-coverage.test.ts: an exception that matches no code, or whose codes all have help, fails the test.

exceptions.axentra.*: Codes of an optional integration with a separate product; that product brings its own help for them.
exceptions.connect.*: Notes of the automatic connection repair in the workflow editor, shown as information next to the change, not as errors.
exceptions.validate.*: Results of the workflow check (ok, fixed, renamed and similar), shown as information; the problems it finds carry their own codes.
